text: Based on the evidence, native forest was deforested in this asset in 2025. The tool detected a tree-cover loss event in 2025, covering 13.5 hectares. About 98% of this area was mapped as forest in 2020 by the JRC. Furthermore, the Uruguayan forest map indicates that 13.1 hectares of this area was native forest. Thus, it's clear that native forest was indeed deforested in 2025.
